business_model.basis: Stated in the 2025 10-K Item 1 and Item 7 and the Q3 2026 10-Q Item 2.
business_model.claim: Accelerant operates the Accelerant Risk Exchange, a data-driven specialty insurance marketplace connecting specialty underwriters (Members) with insurers, reinsurers, and institutional investors (Risk Capital Partners) to serve small-to-medium sized commercial clients primarily in the US, EU, Canada, and the UK.
quotes: We operate a data-driven risk exchange that connects selected specialty insurance underwriters (the “Sellers” on our platform) with Risk Capital Partners (the “Buyers” on our platform).
We focus on small-to-medium sized commercial clients primarily in the US, EU, Canada and the UK.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 2025 10-K Item 1 and Item 7 and the Q3 2026 10-Q Item 2.
business_model.claim: To its Members, Accelerant provides analytics, distribution management, operational, actuarial, and regulatory support, and underwriting capacity, generally under long-term contracts with annual renewals, exclusivity on covered policy types, and a right of first refusal on new products.
quotes: We deliver distribution management and operational, actuarial, regulatory, and stable capital support to our Members, and our holistic offering promotes our Members’ growth and better underwriting performance.
Generally, these contracts are five years in duration and subject to annual renewal, with Accelerant retaining a right to terminate early for performance reasons.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 2025 10-K Item 1 and Item 7 and the Q3 2026 10-Q Item 2.
business_model.claim: To its Risk Capital Partners, Accelerant offers a validated, diversified portfolio of predominantly low-limit, low-hazard specialty commercial risks in exchange for recurring, fixed-percentage, volume-based fees to source, manage, and monitor the portfolio.
quotes: Risk Capital Partners who provide capacity through our Risk Exchange pay us recurring fees to source, manage, and monitor risks on their behalf.

Our Exchange Services segment generates revenue through a fixed-percentage, volume-based fee that our Risk Capital Partners pay to us for sourcing, managing, and monitoring the portfolio of business written by Members.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 1 Business, 10-K Item 7 MD&A, and 10-Q Part I Item 2 MD&A.
competitive_position.claim: Accelerant operates a data-driven Risk Exchange connecting specialty insurance underwriters (Members) on the supply side with Risk Capital Partners on the demand side to reduce information asymmetries and intermediation costs in small-to-medium commercial specialty insurance.
quotes: We operate a data-driven risk exchange that connects selected specialty insurance underwriters (the “Sellers” on our platform) with Risk Capital Partners (the “Buyers” on our platform).

Our Risk Exchange reduces information asymmetries and operational barriers present in the traditional insurance value chain by leveraging proprietary technology to share actionable high-fidelity data and insights with platform participants.
We focus on small-to-medium sized commercial clients primarily in the US, EU, Canada and the UK.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in 10-Q Part I Item 2 MD&A and Q3 2026 8-K earnings release.
competitive_position.claim: As of September 30, 2026, Accelerant's platform reached 340 Members and 94 Risk Capital Partners, with Exchange Written Premium growing at a 164% compounded annual growth rate since inception to $1.33 billion in the third quarter of 2026, up 27% year-over-year.
quotes: As of September 30, 2026, we had 340 Members (an increase of 26 Members since June 30, 2026) and 94 Risk Capital Partners on our platform.
We have grown Exchange Written Premium at a 164% compounded annual growth rate since our inception.
Exchange Written Premium of $1.33 billion grew 27% year-over-year

competitive_position.claim: Accelerant's proprietary data ingestion platform pooled over 58 thousand unique attributes across more than 134 million rows from over 1,800 unique data mappings as of December 31, 2025, enabling Members to launch new products in approximately 14 weeks.
quotes: We collect Member exposure data from both structured and unstructured environments and combine it into a single dataset that, as of December 31, 2025, consisted of over 58 thousand unique attributes across more than 134 million rows of proprietary data from over 1,800 unique data mappings.
We work with Members to launch new product offerings in approximately 14 weeks, compared to what we believe is the industry standard of six to 12 months.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 1 Business, 10-K Item 7 MD&A, and Q3 2026 8-K earnings release.
competitive_position.claim: Since inception, Accelerant declined approximately 90% of prospective new Members (representing over $20 billion in self-reported premiums) to maintain a low-volatility portfolio with gross loss ratios of 51.3% in 2025, 54.3% in 2024, and 51.3% in 2023.
quotes: Since our inception, we have declined approximately 90% of prospective new Members (representing self-reported premiums of over $20 billion in aggregate) that we believe did not fit within our model, reflecting our highly selective approach of inviting only the best MGAs to join our Risk Exchange.

We believe the historic quality of the portfolio written by our Members is reflected by the gross loss ratios of 51.3%, 54.3% and 51.3% for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 1 Business, 10-Q Part I Item 2 MD&A, and Q3 2026 8-K earnings release.
competitive_position.claim: Members grow gross premiums written through the Risk Exchange by 52% on average in their initial years, gave Accelerant an independent third-party Net Promoter Score of 83 (out of 100), and generally sign rolling exclusivity contracts with a right of first refusal on new products.
quotes: On average, our Members grow gross premiums written through the Risk Exchange by 52% in their first two years, or at an annual rate of 39% on a weighted-average basis at low-to-mid 50-percentage loss ratios, on average.
We received an independent third-party Net Promoter Score of 83 (out of 100) from our Members (based on a survey result), which we believe will attract a robust pipeline of potential future Members.
Generally, these contracts are five years in duration and subject to annual renewal, with Accelerant retaining a right to terminate early for performance reasons.
Additionally, Accelerant has the right of first refusal to offer on the Accelerant Risk Exchange any new products an Independent Member may launch.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 7 MD&A and Q3 2026 8-K earnings release.
competitive_position.claim: Accelerant is shifting toward a capital-light, fee-based model, with Third-Party Direct Written Premium growing from 16% of Exchange Written Premium in 2024 to 30% in 2025 and 49% in the third quarter of 2026, while fee-based businesses delivered $84.5 million of adjusted EBITDA in the third quarter of 2026.
quotes: As of December 31, 2025, 18 Risk Exchange Insurers (an increase of three and five Risk Exchange Insurers since September 30, 2025 and December 31, 2024, respectively) accessed gross premium written directly from the Risk Exchange (on a primary insurance basis) rather than via reinsurance from Accelerant Underwriting, accounting for 30% of the premium written on the Risk Exchange for the year ended December 31, 2025, as compared to 16% for the year ended December 31, 2024.
Third-Party Direct Written Premium accounted for 49% of Exchange Written Premium volume
Our fee-based businesses, which we define as consolidated results less the Underwriting segment, delivered $84.5 million of adjusted EBITDA, representing growth of 75% year over year.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 1 Business and 10-Q Part I Item 2 MD&A.
competitive_position.claim: Accelerant expands captive underwriting supply through its Mission Underwriters incubator and equity stakes in Owned Members, reaching 41 Mission Members and 17 Owned Members as of September 30, 2026.
quotes: Mission Underwriters expands our addressable market to include underwriters presently employed by traditional insurance companies looking to form their own MGAs.

With Mission Underwriters, we support entrepreneurial specialty underwriters with start-up capital and operational tools and resources to form their own MGAs that are then jointly owned by Mission Underwriters and the specialty underwriters.

There may be potential Members that are less interested in becoming a Member because of our investment in other Members that are perceived to be competitors, but based on our experience, we believe the likelihood of this is low.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 1A Risk Factors, 10-K Item 7 MD&A, and 10-Q Part I Item 2 MD&A.
competitive_position.claim: Accelerant supports platform capacity with multi-year third-party capital structures including Flywheel Re and WoodStar Reciprocal Exchange ($220 million of surplus notes), alongside an A.M. Best group financial strength rating of “A-” (Excellent).
quotes: The Flywheel Re reinsurance treaty has been extended and upsized through additional capital from new and existing institutional investors, with the most recent upsizing in March 2026 to support business assumed by Flywheel Re over a multi-year risk period scheduled to end in 2028.

WoodStar was funded with a total of $220 million of surplus notes, composed of $160 million investment in surplus notes by unrelated third parties and a $60 million investment in surplus notes by WoodStar Risk Management Inc. ("WRMI"), WoodStar's attorney-in-fact, also funded by unrelated third parties.
As of December 31, 2025, A.M. Best has assigned Accelerant a group financial strength rating of “A-” (Excellent) with a stable outlook as an insurance holding company system.

competitive_position.claim: As a threat to its competitive position, Accelerant faces intense competition from established insurers, consolidating financial services firms, insurtechs, and alternative insurance markets including captives, self-insurance, risk retention groups, parametric insurance, and non-insurance capital markets.
quotes: The insurance intermediary business is highly competitive, and we actively compete with numerous firms for new Members and Risk Capital Partners, many of which have relationships with other insurance companies or have a significant presence in specialty insurance markets that may give them an advantage over us.
Furthermore, there has been an increase in alternative insurance markets, such as self-insurance, captives, risk retention groups, parametric insurance, and non-insurance capital markets.

competitive_position.claim: As a threat to its competitive position, rapid developments in artificial intelligence and competing technology platforms could erode Accelerant's technological differentiation, enable smaller carriers to scale faster, or increase system failures and claims fraud.
quotes: Other companies may be developing platforms that may compete with our Risk Exchange, and their success in this space may adversely impact our ability to differentiate our services to our Members.
From a business perspective, the rapid development of artificial intelligence increases the risk of competition and market disruption.

competitive_position.claim: As a threat to its competitive position, the Risk Exchange has a limited operating history focused on low-volatility SME risks, and adding high-quality Members may slow while expanding into new products could produce higher loss ratios that deter Risk Capital Partners.
quotes: Our Risk Exchange is a new idea in the specialty insurance market, has been built with reality-developed applications, and our portfolio is currently focused on low-volatility, low-severity SME risks.

These new products may result in a higher loss ratio, which may be less attractive for our Members and Risk Capital Partners, and may materially adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, and prospects.
As we continue to add new Members, it may become harder to find high-quality MGAs that meet the requirements of our diligence process.

competitive_position.claim: As a threat to its competitive position, Members may leave the Risk Exchange after their exclusivity periods expire, and incomplete Member data or underwriting guideline breaches could cause higher loss ratios, reputational harm across industry networks, and Risk Capital Partner departures.
quotes: Members may choose to leave our Risk Exchange after the exclusivity period has ended.

If the data we receive from our Members and Risk Capital Partners is inaccurate, incomplete or not timely, our current Members may choose to leave our Risk Exchange, our Risk Capital Partners may mis price risk leading to their dissatisfaction or departure, and our reputation may be harmed, which could materially and adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, and prospects.

However, if our Members do not perform with the expected level of skill, if any of the models or tools that they use contain programming or other errors or are ineffective, or if the data that we expect to be provided by Members or third parties is incorrect or stale, our pricing and approval process could be negatively affected, resulting in higher loss ratios and other adverse outcomes for those Members.

competitive_position.claim: As a threat to its competitive position, Accelerant may be unable to attract Risk Capital Partners or third-party reinsurance at historical growth rates and on acceptable terms, and any A.M. Best rating downgrade could raise reinsurance costs, drive business to higher-rated rivals, or restrict policy writing.
quotes: We have expanded rapidly in recent years, and we may not be able to continue to attract Risk Capital Partners at the same rate or of the same quality to facilitate similar growth in the future continue maintaining a capital-efficient model;

We can offer no assurance that our rating will remain at its current level and future reviews may result in adverse ratings consequences, which could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.

quotes: The announcement and pendency of the Merger, as well as any delays in the expected timeframe, could cause disruption to our ongoing operations and create uncertainties, any of which could have an adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial condition, and trading price of our Class A common shares, regardless of whether the Merger is completed, and could cause us not to realize some or all of the benefits that we expect to achieve if the Merger is successfully completed within its expected timeframe.

quotes: Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the Merger (the “Effective Time”), each Class A common share and Class B common share of the Company, $0.0000011951862 par value per share (the “Shares”), issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time will be converted automatically into the right to receive (A) $20.25 in cash, without interest, plus (B) if applicable, the Ticking Amount (together, the "Per Share Closing Amount”).

Consummation of the Merger is subject to certain customary closing conditions, including, among other things, receipt of Company shareholder approval and applicable regulatory approvals and is expected to close in the first half of 2027.

The announcement and pendency of the Merger, as well as any delays in the expected timeframe, could cause disruption to our ongoing operations and create uncertainties, any of which could have an adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial condition, and trading price of our Class A common shares, regardless of whether the Merger is completed, and could cause us not to realize some or all of the benefits that we expect to achieve if the Merger is successfully completed within its expected timeframe.
Upon completion, Accelerant will become a private company, and its common shares will no longer be listed nor traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

Consummation of the Merger is subject to certain customary closing conditions, including, among other things, receipt of Company shareholder approval and applicable regulatory approvals and is expected to close in the first half of 2027.
